description_for_human: Interactive ML courses for frontend developers. Learn machine learning with JavaScript using familiar concepts.
description_for_model: Tensorcraft is an interactive, story-driven web application that teaches machine learning to frontend developers. It offers 5 worlds (Deep Orbit for time-series, Neon Protocol for computer vision, Signal Ward for NLP, Nova Canvas for generative AI, Terra Grid for edge AI) with 275 total lessons. Key differentiator: 50+ 'bridge' analogies map frontend concepts (useState, Array.map, fetch) to ML equivalents (model weights, tensor ops, inference API). All models run in the browser via TensorFlow.js. Pricing: $59 per world, Module 1 free. URL: https://tensorcraft.app
